column1: # D1 pairwise epistasis: full-panel singleton extraction of the frozen 64-background
# double-mutant cohort (8,192 cycles, 12,977 deduplicated sequences, 779,664 residues).
# The roster is the complete pre-declared unconditioned Readout panel of 33 checkpoints,
# frozen in src/transfer/pairwise_epistasis.py:ROSTER before any pairwise scoring and
# not a function of any outcome. ZymCTRL is excluded as a conditioned interface.
# Scheduling only: one lane per GPU, arms run serially inside a lane, lanes run
# concurrently across the four allocations. Lane totals are balanced against the
# label-blind throughput qualification measured on three backgrounds per arm
# (4.6 sequences/s for galactica-30b to 183 sequences/s for gpt2).
